# Absorb

Absorb is a local-first RSVP reading app for focused, faster reading. It displays text one word at a time, highlights the optimal recognition point, and helps readers reduce eye movement and subvocalization.

## Product Notes

- Platform: iOS app distributed through the Apple App Store.
- Core use case: focused speed reading for EPUBs, PDFs, text files, and public domain books.
- Privacy posture: no Absorb account required; reading content and progress are designed to stay on device.
- Canonical site assumption: https://iimaximus.github.io/absorb_web.
- App Store listing: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/read-fast-absorb/id6759666710.
